pages.title: Elasmotherium
pages.text: The Elasmotherium ($(o)Elasmotherium sibiricum$()) is an extinct giant rhinoceros that lived on the steppes of eastern Europe and Central Asia during the Pleistocene, surviving until at least 39,000 years ago.$(br2)It was a grazer, with large, high-crowned cheek teeth for chewing tough grasses.$(br2)A huge domed bony boss on its forehead is thought to have supported a single large horn, earning it the nickname Siberian unicorn.
